title: Close 2026-06-30 D&D SRD audit findings
description:
Parent epic for the 2026-06-30 / 2026-07-01 D&D SRD 5.1 audit round.

This epic groups the Codex GPT-5.5 max-effort findings already filed plus the remaining findings from the Claude Opus 4.8 review and ChatGPT review.

Scope:
- Source-coverage proof gaps: sidebars, continuation-only pages, page inventory, duplicate heading ownership, and source regions that are counted as represented without being present or structurally encoded in the owning record.
- Multi-page provenance locator completeness for primary DM source discoverability.
- Missing SRD skill-to-ability mapping from p.78 and the coverage false negative that hid it.
- Equipment grouping semantics needed by deterministic tools: weapon simple/martial and melee/ranged categories, foci, holy symbols, instruments, tools, and starting-equipment filter resolution.
- Gameplay-readiness report accuracy for creature mechanics projections.
- Deterministic modeling improvements for armor AC formulas.
- Minor modeling cleanup from this audit round, including Enlarge/Reduce weapon-damage delta modeling and Potion of Healing display normalization.

Already-created Codex beads to include under this epic:
- eshyra-5c7f: source coverage evidence incomplete for sidebars/unaccounted pages.
- eshyra-lpk9: multi-page provenance locators incomplete.
- eshyra-txxa: gameplay-readiness undercounts creature mechanics projections.
- eshyra-rtgi: armor AC not structured enough for deterministic tools.

Do not hand-edit the generated pack. Fixes belong in the deterministic importer, schema/modeling layer, resolver/audit scripts, and regression tests.
notes:
2026-07-01: PR #380 merged (merge commit 7579fec6). Reviewer flagged two things:
1. srdEquipmentResolutionAudit.ts's namedItemCandidates() returns [key] unchecked, so a typo'd named-item equipment key would still pass assertEquipmentResolution (length>0 only). Filed eshyra-erf5.7 to fix + add regression test.
2. Bookkeeping caution about not closing eshyra-5c7f prematurely -- already correct: 5c7f remains OPEN with deferred acceptance criteria documented and linked to erf5.5.
Epic stays open pending erf5.5, erf5.6, erf5.7.
close_reason: All 11 children complete. Final three follow-ups (erf5.5/.6/.7) plus 5c7f's last criterion land in PR #381 (open for review); earlier children merged via PR #380.
